_cacheNote: Prompt-cache multipliers on the input rate: a write costs 1.25x (5-minute TTL), a read 0.1x. Only the response-generation call is cached.
_speechNote: Per-service speech rates. Neither service wins both halves: Azure hears at about twice Deepgram's price and speaks at about half it. List prices; the estimate ignores each service's free allowance, so a light user owes less.
